# C1: input custody. Hash the eight implementation files and compare with the

R = "/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher"

def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
def sha_commit(c,p): return hashlib.sha256(subprocess.run(['git','show',f'{c}:{p}'],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout).hexdigest()
plans = sorted(glob.glob("experiments/EXP-QSP-70b731/trial-plan*.json"))
impl = sorted(glob.glob("experiments/EXP-QSP-70b731/implementation/*.py"))
print("impl files:", len(impl))
for p in impl:
    print(p, sha(p), "commit-equal:", sha(p)==sha_commit("2d5deb6b62",p))
for pl in plans:
    d = json.load(open(pl))
    src = d.get("source_sha256", {})
    mism = [k for k,v in src.items() if sha(k)!=v]
    missing = [p for p in impl if p not in src]
    rids = [t.get("run_id") for t in d.get("trials",[])]
    print(pl, "plan_sha", sha(pl), "commit-equal", sha(pl)==sha_commit("2d5deb6b62",pl),
          "n_src", len(src), "mismatch", mism, "impl_not_in_src", missing,
          "spec_sha_ok", d.get("specification_sha256")==sha("experiments/EXP-QSP-70b731/specification.yaml"),
          "n_trials", len(rids))
    print("   run_ids:", rids)
    print("   trial ids:", [t.get("id") for t in d.get("trials",[])])

computations.script:
# C2: attack (vi). Extract the two code blocks from the COMMITTED design bytes
# (git show 2d5deb6b62) by the design's pinned method, hash them, run each
# through its __main__ entry in a subprocess, and compare stdout line by line
# with the design's relayed D-C3 and D-C4 outputs (the 'output' literal blocks,
# with the trailing '[exit 0]' marker removed). Arithmetic on the frozen bound
# formula and polynomial counting only; no field arithmetic, no N, root, gcd or
# H polynomial (the blocks' own docstrings; read before running).
import hashlib, subprocess, sys, yaml, os, json
S = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) + "/dc"
doc = yaml.safe_load(open(S + "/repair-design.committed.yaml", encoding="utf-8"))
rd = doc["repair_design"]
B = rd["code_blocks"]
ok = True
for k in ("route_table_code", "candidate_count_code"):
    src = B[k]["source"]
    h = hashlib.sha256(src.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    n = open(S + "/" + k + ".py", "w", encoding="utf-8").write(src)
    print(k, h, n, "ref_match", h == B[k]["reference_sha256"])
    ok &= h == B[k]["reference_sha256"]
for k, dc in (("route_table_code", "D-C3"), ("candidate_count_code", "D-C4")):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, k + ".py"], cwd=S, capture_output=True, text=True)
    relayed = rd["session_computations"][dc]["output"].rstrip("\n").split("\n")
    assert relayed[-1] == "[exit 0]", relayed[-1]
    relayed = relayed[:-1]
    got = p.stdout.rstrip("\n").split("\n")
    same = got == relayed
    ok &= same and p.returncode == 0
    diffs = [(i, a, b) for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(got, relayed)) if a != b]
    print(dc, "exit", p.returncode, "stderr_bytes", len(p.stderr), "lines_got", len(got), "lines_relayed", len(relayed), "identical", same, "first_diffs", diffs[:3])
    open(S + "/" + dc + ".stdout.txt", "w").write(p.stdout)
    print(dc, "stdout_sha256", hashlib.sha256(p.stdout.encode()).hexdigest())
print("ALL_REPRODUCE", ok)

    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", R, "show", f"{c}:{p}"], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
paths = ["experiments/EXP-QSP-70b731/specification.yaml"] + [f"experiments/EXP-QSP-70b731/{f}" for f in
    ("trial-plan.json","trial-plan-v2.json","trial-plan-run.json","trial-plan-run2.json","trial-plan-run3.json","trial-plan-cont.json")] + \
    [f"experiments/EXP-QSP-70b731/implementation/{f}" for f in ("__init__.py","candidates.py","check.py","driver.py","field_f2n.py","gf2_poly.py","i_direct.py","i_indep.py")] + \
    ["tools/validate_ledger.py", "tools/experiment_execution.py"]
for c in ("2d5deb6b62", "HEAD"):
    got = [f"{hashlib.sha256(blob(c,p)).hexdigest()} {p}" for p in paths]
    rel = rd["session_computations"]["D-C5"]["output"].rstrip("\n").split("\n")[:-1]
    print("D-C5 at", c, "identical:", got == rel, "n", len(got), len(rel),
          "diffs:", [(a.split()[1]) for a, b in zip(got, rel) if a != b])
out = []

    for t in json.loads(blob("2d5deb6b62", "experiments/EXP-QSP-70b731/" + f))["trials"]:
        out.append(f"{f} {t['id']} {t['run_id']} {json.dumps(t.get('depends_on', []))}")
rel6 = rd["session_computations"]["D-C6"]["output"].rstrip("\n").split("\n")[:-1]
print("D-C6 identical:", out == rel6, len(out), len(rel6))
union = sorted({l.split()[2] for l in out})
print("union_run_ids", len(union), union)

def wo_r2_presence(dirname):
    p = os.path.join(S, dirname, "manifest.yaml")
    if not os.path.exists(p): return ["no manifest"]
    doc = yaml.safe_load(open(p)); body = doc.get("run") if isinstance(doc, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(body, dict): return ["no run mapping"]
    miss = []
    for k, sub in WO_R2.items():
        if k not in body: miss.append(k); continue
        if sub:
            if not isinstance(body[k], dict) or not body[k]: miss.append(k + " (empty)"); continue
            for f in sub:
                if f not in body[k]: miss.append(k + "." + f)
                elif body[k][f] is None and (k, f) not in NULLABLE_WITH_REASON: miss.append(k + "." + f + " (null)")
        elif body[k] in (None, ""): miss.append(k + " (null)")
    return miss

def full_body(rid, status="completed", pending=False):
    b = {"id": rid, "experiment_id": "EXP-SYNTH", "trial_id": "syn-a-15-04", "status": status,
         "plan": {"path": "scratch/plan.json", "sha256": "0"*64, "authority_commit": "f"*40, "task_id": "TASK-SYNTH", "approved_by": "DEC-SYNTH"},
         "code": {"commit": "a"*40, "dirty": False, "dirty_paths": [], "command": "python3 main.py --synthetic syn-a-15-04", "entry": "r1/runner/main.py",
                  "source_sha256": {"r1/runner/main.py": "1"*64}, "specification_sha256": "2"*64, "amendment_sha256": "3"*64},

                       "model_verified": False, "reasoning_effort": "medium", "fallback_used": False, "fallback_reason": None, "degraded_requirements": [],
                       "context_path": "scratch/context.yaml", "context_sha256": "4"*64, "payload_model_invocations": 0},
         "inputs": {"parameters": {"stage": "synthetic", "n": 15, "n_prime": 4, "field_bits": 15}, "seeds": {"base_seed": 20260920, "rule": "sha256(label)[:8]"},
                    "context": {"path": "scratch/context.yaml", "sha256": "4"*64}, "read_set": {"files": [], "blind_from_respected": True}},

                    "peak_rss_mb": 10.0, "per_route_seconds": {}},

                    "valid": None if pending else True, "validity_status": "incomplete" if pending else "valid",
                    "validity_reason": "attempt in progress" if pending else "all checks passed", "invalid_reason": None, "f_codes": [], "stop_code": None,
                    "accounting": None, "metrics": None, "headline": None}}
    if pending: b["result"]["raw_result_pending"] = True
    return b

def make(dirname, doc, companions=("command.txt", "environment.json", "stdout.log", "stderr.log"), raw=True, write_manifest=True):
    d = os.path.join(S, dirname); os.makedirs(d)
    for c in companions: open(os.path.join(d, c), "w").write("synthetic\n")
    if raw: open(os.path.join(d, "raw-result.json"), "w").write("{}\n")
    if write_manifest: yaml.safe_dump(doc, open(os.path.join(d, "manifest.yaml"), "w"), sort_keys=False)

cases = []
# A1 conforming terminal record

computations.purpose: attack (ii): AC-3, AC-4, honest F-02 shape, C5 with-replacement interaction, swap; synthetic n = 5 cell
computations.script:
# C5: attack (ii) for AC-3, AC-4 (D-2, accounting half of D-3) and the C5
# with-replacement interaction. A literal model of WO-R-6/7/8 (payload: rows,
# certs/<cell slug>/<lambda hex>.json, certificates-index.json, accounting from
# files on disk, identity before headline) and WO-R-9 (checker: re-hash, root
# re-verification, accounting recomputed from disk "must equal the payload's").
# Everything runs on ONE SYNTHETIC CELL syn-x-05-02: n = 5 (outside {4, 7, 11,
# 12, 13, 31, 131}), n' = 2, K = F_2[z]/(z^5+z^2+1). Roots by brute force over
# the 32 elements of this synthetic field only. No declared cell is touched.
import hashlib, json, os, random, shutil
S = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) + "/acct"
N_FIELD, N_PRIME, MOD = 5, 2, (1 << 5) | (1 << 2) | 1
def kmul(a, b):
    r = 0
    while b:
        if b & 1: r ^= a
        b >>= 1; a <<= 1
        if a >> N_FIELD: a ^= MOD
    return r
def kpow2k(x, k):
    for _ in range(k): x = kmul(x, x)
    return x
def lam_eval(lam, x):
    acc, p, i = 0, 1, 0
    while lam >> i:
        if (lam >> i) & 1: acc ^= p
        p = kmul(p, x); i += 1
    return acc
def is_root(lam, x): return kpow2k(x, N_PRIME) == lam_eval(lam, x)
def irreducible(m, n):  # trial division by every polynomial of degree 1..n//2
    def pmod(a, b):
        db = b.bit_length() - 1
        while a and a.bit_length() - 1 >= db: a ^= b << (a.bit_length() - 1 - db)
        return a
    return all(pmod(m, f) for f in range(2, 1 << (n // 2 + 1)))
assert irreducible(MOD, N_FIELD)
CELL = "syn-x-05-02"
def roots(lam): return sorted(x for x in range(1 << N_FIELD) if is_root(lam, x))
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest()

def payload(dirname, lams, skip_cert_for=None, underlist=None, phantom=None):
    d = os.path.join(S, dirname); shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(d + "/certs/" + CELL)
    rows, index = [], []
    for lam in lams:
        rs = roots(lam); N = len(rs); listed = rs[:-1] if (underlist == lam and N) else rs
        path = None
        if N > 0 and lam != skip_cert_for:
            path = f"certs/{CELL}/{lam:x}.json"
            json.dump({"cell": CELL, "lambda": f"{lam:x}", "N": N, "roots": [f"{x:x}" for x in listed]}, open(os.path.join(d, path), "w"))
        rows.append({"lambda": f"{lam:x}", "I_indep_N": N, "root_count_listed": len(listed), "certificate_path": path, "status": "completed"})
    if phantom is not None:
        rs = roots(phantom); path = f"certs/{CELL}/{phantom:x}.json"
        json.dump({"cell": CELL, "lambda": f"{phantom:x}", "N": len(rs), "roots": [f"{x:x}" for x in rs]}, open(os.path.join(d, path), "w"))
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(d + "/certs/" + CELL)):
        p = f"certs/{CELL}/{f}"; c = json.load(open(os.path.join(d, p)))
        index.append({"path": p, "sha256": sha(os.path.join(d, p)), "N": c["N"], "verified": True})
    json.dump(index, open(d + "/certificates-index.json", "w"))
    open(d + "/rows.jsonl", "w").write("".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in rows))
    acct = accounting(d)
    raw = {"rows": rows, "accounting": acct, "headline": ("certificate_bearing=%d" % acct["certificate_bearing"]) if acct["identity_holds"] else None,
           "validity_status": "valid" if acct["identity_holds"] else "invalid", "f_codes": [] if acct["identity_holds"] else ["F_acct"]}
    json.dump(raw, open(d + "/raw-result.json", "w"))
    return d

def accounting(d):  # WO-R-8 as written: certificate_bearing counts FILES
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(d + "/rows.jsonl")]
    index = json.load(open(d + "/certificates-index.json"))
    files = sorted("certs/%s/%s" % (CELL, f) for f in os.listdir(d + "/certs/" + CELL))
    bearing = 0
    for e in index:
        p = os.path.join(d, e["path"])
        if os.path.exists(p) and sha(p) == e["sha256"]:
            c = json.load(open(p)); lam = int(c["lambda"], 16)
            if c["N"] > 0 and all(is_root(lam, int(x, 16)) for x in c["roots"]) and len(set(c["roots"])) == c["N"]:
                bearing += 1
    completed = sum(1 for r in rows if r["status"] == "completed")
    zero = sum(1 for r in rows if r["I_indep_N"] == 0)
    return {"rows_completed": completed, "zero_N_rows": zero, "positive_rows": completed - zero, "certificate_bearing": bearing,
            "files_on_disk": len(files), "identity_holds": bearing + zero == completed,
            "files_equal_index": files == sorted(e["path"] for e in index),
            "underlisted_rows": sum(1 for r in rows if r["root_count_listed"] != r["I_indep_N"])}

def checker(d, strict=False):  # WO-R-9 accounting clauses, as written (+ optional identity gate)
    index = json.load(open(d + "/certificates-index.json"))
    for e in index:
        p = os.path.join(d, e["path"])
        if not os.path.exists(p) or sha(p) != e["sha256"]: return 3, "file vs index"
        c = json.load(open(p)); lam = int(c["lambda"], 16)
        if not all(is_root(lam, int(x, 16)) for x in c["roots"]) or len(set(c["roots"])) != c["N"]: return 3, "root re-verification"
    re = accounting(d); pay = json.load(open(d + "/raw-result.json"))["accounting"]
    if re != pay: return 3, "recomputed accounting != payload's"
    if re["underlisted_rows"]: return 3, "row root_count_listed != I_indep_N (WO-R-8)"
    if strict and not re["identity_holds"]: return 3, "identity fails (strict reading)"
    return 0, "ok"

def ac3_reviewer(d):  # AC-3 procedure: every N > 0 row has its own verified file; identity before headline
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(d + "/rows.jsonl")]
    for r in rows:
        if r["I_indep_N"] > 0:
            p = r["certificate_path"]
            if not p or not os.path.exists(os.path.join(d, p)): return "FAIL (N>0 row %s without file)" % r["lambda"]
            c = json.load(open(os.path.join(d, p)))
            if c["lambda"] != r["lambda"] or c["N"] != r["I_indep_N"]: return "FAIL (file not bound to row %s)" % r["lambda"]
    raw = json.load(open(d + "/raw-result.json"))
    if raw["headline"] is not None and not raw["accounting"]["identity_holds"]: return "FAIL (headline with identity failing)"
    return "pass"

def report(label, d):
    a = json.load(open(d + "/raw-result.json"))["accounting"]
    print(json.dumps({"case": label, "payload_accounting": a, "payload_validity": json.load(open(d + "/raw-result.json"))["validity_status"],
                      "checker_literal": checker(d), "checker_strict": checker(d, True), "AC3_reviewer": ac3_reviewer(d)}))

exhaustive = list(range(4, 16))   # every F_2 lambda of exact degree 2 or 3 (12), each once
pos = [l for l in exhaustive if roots(l)]
print("synthetic cell", CELL, "modulus irreducible", True, "candidates", len(exhaustive), "N>0 candidates", len(pos))
d = payload("B1", exhaustive); report("B1 conforming exhaustive", d)
d = payload("B2", exhaustive); os.remove(os.path.join(d, f"certs/{CELL}/{pos[0]:x}.json")); report("B2 PTM-R1 delete one cert after the payload", d)
d = payload("B3", exhaustive); p = os.path.join(d, f"certs/{CELL}/{pos[0]:x}.json"); c = json.load(open(p)); c["roots"][0] = "1f" if c["roots"][0] != "1f" else "1e"; json.dump(c, open(p, "w")); report("B3 PTM-R1 alter one root after the payload", d)
d = payload("B4", exhaustive); r = json.load(open(d + "/raw-result.json")); r["accounting"]["certificate_bearing"] += 1; json.dump(r, open(d + "/raw-result.json", "w")); report("B4 PTM-R1 inflate reported certificate_bearing", d)
d = payload("B5", exhaustive, skip_cert_for=pos[0]); report("B5 F-02 shape inside the payload: cert writer skips one N>0 row; accounting honest", d)
multi = [l for l in pos if len(roots(l)) >= 2]
d = payload("B6", exhaustive, underlist=multi[0]); report("B6 PTM-R2 root_count_listed below I_indep_N", d)
rng = random.Random(int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(b"SYNTHETIC|C5-like|syn-x-05-02|d=2").digest()[:8], "big"))
sample = [rng.randrange(4, 8) for _ in range(30)]   # 30 draws WITH REPLACEMENT from the 4 exact-degree-2 lambda
dups = {f"{l:x}": sample.count(l) for l in sorted(set(sample))}
print(json.dumps({"with_replacement_sample_counts": dups, "pigeonhole": "30 draws over 4 values", "N_per_value": {f"{l:x}": len(roots(l)) for l in range(4, 8)}}))
d = payload("B7", sample); report("B7 C5-style sample with replacement, cert path keyed by lambda hex", d)
d = payload("B8", [l for l in exhaustive if l != pos[1]] + [pos[1]], skip_cert_for=pos[1], phantom=8 + 16 if roots(24) else None)
report("B8 swap: one N>0 row without a file, one phantom file for a lambda outside the rows", d)

computations.purpose: attacks (ii), (iii), (iv): AC-10 and AC-24 on reviewer stubs; bound driver/check imports read statically
computations.script:
# C6: attack (iv) and (ii) for AC-10 (Stage 0 has no census-code path) and
# AC-24 (wrapper and checker import no r1/indep module). Stub packages written
# by this reviewer in private scratch (package name r1s, never r1). Each stub
# is a few lines; no field arithmetic. The bound closure is read STATICALLY
# (ast.parse of driver.py and check.py text; nothing imported or executed).
import ast, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, json
S = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) + "/imp"
CENSUS = ["r1s.runner.census", "r1s.runner.controls", "r1s.runner.i_direct", "r1s.runner.kfield", "r1s.runner.certs", "r1s.runner.compare"]
GUARD = ("import sys\nBAD=" + repr(CENSUS) + "\n"
         "def guard():\n    hit=[m for m in sys.modules if m in BAD or m.startswith('r1s.indep')]\n"
         "    if hit:\n        print('GUARD-HIT', hit); sys.exit(9)\n")
def build(name, files):
    root = os.path.join(S, name); shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
    for rel, src in files.items():
        p = os.path.join(root, rel); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True); open(p, "w").write(src)
    return root
base = {"r1s/__init__.py": "", "r1s/runner/__init__.py": "", "r1s/indep/__init__.py": "",
        "r1s/indep/api.py": "from r1s.indep import fieldk\n", "r1s/indep/fieldk.py": "def mul(a,b): return 0\n",
        "r1s/runner/manifest.py": "import json\n", "r1s/runner/readset.py": "import hashlib\n", "r1s/runner/context.py": "import yaml\n",
        "r1s/runner/errors.py": "", "r1s/runner/census.py": "from r1s.indep import api\n", "r1s/runner/controls.py": "from r1s.indep import api\n",
        "r1s/runner/i_direct.py": "", "r1s/runner/kfield.py": "def mul(a,b): return 0\n", "r1s/runner/certs.py": "from r1s.runner import kfield\n",
        "r1s/runner/accounting.py": "from r1s.runner import kfield\n", "r1s/runner/compare.py": "",
        "r1s/runner/check.py": "from r1s.runner import kfield, accounting\n",
        "r1s/runner/stage0.py": GUARD + "guard()\nfrom r1s.runner import manifest, readset, context, errors\nguard()\nprint('STAGE0-OK')\n",
        "r1s/runner/main.py": "import sys\nif sys.argv[1]=='stage0':\n    from r1s.runner import stage0\n"}
ALLOWED0 = {"r1s.runner.manifest", "r1s.runner.readset", "r1s.runner.context", "r1s.runner.errors"}
def imports_of(root, mod):
    p = os.path.join(root, *mod.split(".")) + ".py"
    if not os.path.exists(p): p = os.path.join(root, *mod.split("."), "__init__.py")
    out = set()
    for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(open(p).read())):
        if isinstance(n, ast.Import): out |= {a.name for a in n.names}
        elif isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and n.module:
            for a in n.names:
                sub = n.module + "." + a.name
                out.add(sub if os.path.exists(os.path.join(root, *sub.split(".")) + ".py") else n.module)
        elif isinstance(n, ast.Call) and getattr(n.func, "attr", "") == "import_module": out.add("<importlib.import_module>")
    return {m for m in out if m.startswith("r1s") or m.startswith("<")}
def closure(root, mod):
    seen, todo = set(), [mod]
    while todo:
        m = todo.pop()
        for x in imports_of(root, m) - seen:
            seen.add(x)
            if not x.startswith("<"): todo.append(x)
    return seen
def ac10(root, entry="r1s.runner.stage0", run_via_main=False):
    static_bad = sorted(m for m in closure(root, entry) if m.startswith("<") or (m not in ALLOWED0 and m.startswith("r1s.") and m not in ("r1s", "r1s.runner")))
    cmd = [sys.executable, "-c", "import runpy,sys;sys.argv=['main','stage0'];runpy.run_module('r1s.runner.main',run_name='__main__')"] if run_via_main \
          else [sys.executable, "-m", "r1s.runner.stage0"]
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return {"static_transitive_violations": static_bad, "runtime_exit": p.returncode, "stdout": p.stdout.strip()}
def ac24(root, transitive=False, include_kfield=False):
    mods = ["r1s.runner.certs", "r1s.runner.accounting", "r1s.runner.check"] + (["r1s.runner.kfield"] if include_kfield else [])
    bad = {}
    for m in mods:
        imps = closure(root, m) if transitive else imports_of(root, m)
        hits = sorted(x for x in imps if x.startswith("r1s.indep"))
        if hits: bad[m] = hits
    return "FAIL " + json.dumps(bad) if bad else "pass"
out = {}
r = build("C6a_clean", base); out["C6a clean stage0 (AC-10)"] = ac10(r); out["C6a via main.py"] = ac10(r, run_via_main=True)
f = dict(base); f["r1s/runner/stage0.py"] = GUARD + "guard()\nfrom r1s.runner import manifest, readset, context, errors\nimport r1s.runner.census\nguard()\nprint('STAGE0-OK')\n"
r = build("C6b_ptm_r6", f); out["C6b PTM-R6 import census in stage0"] = ac10(r)
f = dict(base); f["r1s/runner/manifest.py"] = "import json\nfrom r1s.runner import census\n"
r = build("C6c_transitive", f); out["C6c census reached through manifest.py"] = ac10(r)

computations.script:
# C7: attack (iv) and (ii) for AC-11 (M9, D-6, CC-4). A literal model of the
# WO-R-11 matching rule ("matches each path against the ten blind_from entries
# (exact match, or prefix match for entries ending in a slash)"; true only if
# every declaration exists, is non-empty and has no hit), applied to constructed
# declaration strings. Paths are compared as STRINGS; nothing named is opened.
# The ten entries are copied from specification.yaml independence_declaration.
import json, os, posixpath, yaml
SPEC = "/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher/experiments/EXP-QSP-70b731/specification.yaml"
BF = yaml.safe_load(open(SPEC))["experiment"]["independence_declaration"]["blind_from"]
assert len(BF) == 10
def literal_hits(paths):
    return [p for p in paths for b in BF if p == b or (b.endswith("/") and p.startswith(b))]
def literal_respected(decls):  # decls: list of (exists, entries)
    return all(ex and entries and not literal_hits(entries) for ex, entries in decls)
REPO = "/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher"
def canon(entry):  # one possible repair: bare repo-relative POSIX path, normalised
    p = entry.strip()
    if " (" in p: p = p.split(" (", 1)[0]
    if p.startswith(REPO + "/"): p = p[len(REPO) + 1:]
    p = posixpath.normpath(p)
    return p
def repaired_hits(paths):
    out = []
    for e in paths:
        p = canon(e)
        for b in BF:
            bb = b.rstrip("/")
            if p == bb or p.startswith(bb + "/") or bb.startswith(p + "/"):
                out.append(e); break
    return out
clean = ["ledger/hypotheses/H-QSP-cd0c90.yaml", "ledger/proposals/IDEA-20260916-3f7a1c.yaml", "experiments/EXP-QSP-70b731/specification.yaml"]
cases = [
  ("a clean declaration (AC-11 case a)", [(True, clean)], False),
  ("b lists experiments/EXP-QSP-33b442/runs/ (AC-11 case b)", [(True, clean + ["experiments/EXP-QSP-33b442/runs/"])], True),
  ("c empty declaration (AC-11 case c)", [(True, [])], True),
  ("d missing file (AC-11 case d)", [(False, None)], True),
  ("e file under a blind_from directory", [(True, clean + ["experiments/EXP-QSP-33b442/runs/RUN-QSP-33b442-S3/cell-33.json"])], True),
  ("f blind_from FILE in the design's own 'path (extent)' format", [(True, clean + ["knowledge/techniques/KN-TECH-54c38e.md (full)"])], True),
  ("g blind_from FILE as an absolute path", [(True, clean + [REPO + "/analysis/qsp-ecc2k130/explore/explore.json"])], True),
  ("h './' prefix on a blind_from directory member", [(True, clean + ["./experiments/EXP-QSP-33b442/implementation/x.py"])], True),
  ("i blind_from directory named without the trailing slash", [(True, clean + ["experiments/EXP-QSP-33b442/runs"])], True),
  ("j '..' traversal to a blind_from file", [(True, clean + ["experiments/EXP-QSP-70b731/../EXP-QSP-33b442/analysis.md"])], True),
  ("k parent directory of blind_from entries read whole", [(True, clean + ["experiments/EXP-QSP-33b442/"])], True),
  ("l directory annotated with extent (prefix still matches)", [(True, clean + ["experiments/EXP-QSP-33b442/amendments/ (file names only)"])], True),
]
for label, decls, should_be_false in cases:
    lit = literal_respected(decls)
    rep = all(ex and entries and not repaired_hits(entries) for ex, entries in decls)
    print(json.dumps({"case": label, "should_be_respected": not should_be_false, "WO-R-11_literal_blind_from_respected": lit,
                      "literal_correct": lit == (not should_be_false), "repaired_rule": rep, "repaired_correct": rep == (not should_be_false)}))
rd = yaml.safe_load(open(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) + "/dc/repair-design.committed.yaml"))["repair_design"]
pio = rd["read_attestation"]["paths_in_order"]
print(json.dumps({"design_read_attestation_entries_total": len(pio), "entries_with_extent_annotation": sum(1 for e in pio if " (" in e), "examples": pio[2:5]}))

# C11: AC-21 (F1 stop) and AC-22 (freeze before COMPARE) as literal decision
# models on synthetic raw results; AC-15 Linux-gate model; static facts of
# tools/experiment_execution.py read from its text (never run). Synthetic
# values only; the "sealed" fixture is a scratch file whose open is trapped.
import ast, builtins, hashlib, json, os, re, shutil
S = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) + "/f1"
shutil.rmtree(S, ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(S)
def f1_exit(rows):  # WO-R-9 clause: any non-square row with verified N above its bound -> exit 6
    return 6 if any((not r["square"]) and r["wrapper_verified"] and r["N"] > r["bound"] for r in rows) else 0
print(json.dumps({"AC-21": {
  "non-square row, mutated bound": f1_exit([{"square": False, "wrapper_verified": True, "N": 9, "bound": 8}]),
  "square row, same state": f1_exit([{"square": True, "wrapper_verified": True, "N": 9, "bound": 8}]),
  "non-square row within bound": f1_exit([{"square": False, "wrapper_verified": True, "N": 8, "bound": 8}])}}))
# AC-22 model of WO-R-14: verify freeze sha256 values before opening anything sealed
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
for name in ("raw-result.json", "certificates-index.json"): open(os.path.join(S, name), "w").write("{}\n")
freeze = {"frozen": True, "raw_result_sha256": sha(S + "/raw-result.json"), "certificates_index_sha256": sha(S + "/certificates-index.json")}
SEALED = S + "/sealed-fixture.json"; open(SEALED, "w").write("{}\n")
real_open = builtins.open
def trapped(p, *a, **k):
    if os.path.abspath(str(p)) == SEALED: raise RuntimeError("sealed fixture opened")
    return real_open(p, *a, **k)
def compare(freeze, receipt_status="output_validated"):
    builtins.open = trapped
    try:
        if receipt_status != "output_validated" or not freeze.get("frozen"): return 1
        if sha(S + "/raw-result.json") != freeze["raw_result_sha256"] or sha(S + "/certificates-index.json") != freeze["certificates_index_sha256"]: return 1
        open(SEALED).read(); return 0
    except RuntimeError as e: return "opened sealed: " + str(e)
    finally: builtins.open = real_open
r0 = compare(freeze)
open(S + "/raw-result.json", "a").write(" ")
r1 = compare(freeze)
print(json.dumps({"AC-22": {"untouched_freeze -> proceeds to open sealed (trapped here)": r0, "raw result changed after freeze": r1}}))
# AC-15 model: payload gate refuses non-linux with exit 2
def gate(platform): return 2 if platform != "linux" else 0
print(json.dumps({"AC-15 gate": {"linux": gate("linux"), "darwin (patched)": gate("darwin")}}))

src = open("/home/user/crypto-autoresearcher/tools/experiment_execution.py").read()

  "checker non-zero -> invalid_output": "\"output_validated\" if check_returncode == 0 else \"invalid_output\"" in src,
  "run directory exclusive (mkdir, never reused)": "directory.mkdir()  # exclusive" in src,
  "load_plan requires non-empty approved_by": "for field in (\"experiment_id\", \"task_id\", \"approved_by\", \"specification\", \"queue\")" in src,

computations.purpose: attack (ii): AC-21 well-posedness (H can vanish only if d^(q+1) = 2^s)
computations.script:
# C12: AC-21 well-posedness. WO-R-9 fires F1 on any NON-SQUARE row with
# verified N above its bound; the specification's bound carries the hypothesis
# H != 0. H(Y) = Y^(2^s) + lambda^(o(q+1))(Y) can vanish only if its two
# leading degrees coincide, d^(q+1) == 2^s. This checks that degree equation
# on every (cell, d) of the design's route_map: integer arithmetic on the
# frozen bound formula only (the class of D-C3 and JD3's Q2); no H, root, gcd
# or N is computed, and no lambda is examined.
import json, os, yaml
rd = yaml.safe_load(open(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)) + "/dc/repair-design.committed.yaml"))["repair_design"]
ties = []; checked = 0
for cell, v in rd["route_table"]["route_map"]["cells"].items():
    n, np_ = v["n"], v["n_prime"]; q, r = divmod(n, np_); s = np_ - r
    for d in v["routes"]:
        checked += 1
        if d ** (q + 1) == 2 ** s: ties.append({"cell": cell, "d": d, "q": q, "s": s, "routes": v["routes"][d]})
print(json.dumps({"cell_degree_pairs_checked": checked, "pairs_with_d^(q+1)==2^s": ties}))
